scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names 'WEB,API,WRK' --prefix-colors 'cyan,magenta,yellow' 'npm run dev --workspace frontend' 'npm run dev --workspace backend' 'npm run worker --workspace backend'
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend --if-present && npm run lint --workspace backend --if-present
scripts.start: concurrently --names 'WEB,API,WRK' --prefix-colors 'cyan,magenta,yellow' 'npm run start --workspace frontend' 'npm run start --workspace backend' 'npm run start:worker --workspace backend'
